quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Time
quests.contextSentence: ___ the pilot program proves successful, the city plans to expand it to every district.
quests.completedSentence: Once the pilot program proves successful, the city plans to expand it to every district.
quests.ruleExplanation: Reaching proven success is the one-time completed condition that unlocks expansion, which 'once' captures rather than a repeated or unpredictable trigger.
quests.nativeTip: Expansion depends on reaching one specific completed milestone, not a repeating pattern.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Time
quests.contextSentence: ___ budget season rolls around, department heads brace for another round of cuts.
quests.completedSentence: Whenever budget season rolls around, department heads brace for another round of cuts.
quests.ruleExplanation: This describes a recurring institutional pattern repeating every cycle, not a one-time milestone, which is exactly what 'whenever' captures.
quests.nativeTip: This happens every single time that recurring season arrives, year after year.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Time

quests.nativeTip: Integration depends on reaching that single specific milestone, not a recurring event.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Concession
quests.contextSentence: ___ the pilot data already showed strong results, the committee insisted on a second round of testing.
quests.completedSentence: Even though the pilot data already showed strong results, the committee insisted on a second round of testing.
quests.ruleExplanation: The data already exists as an established fact, and 'even though' introduces a concession about something real rather than a possibility.
quests.nativeTip: The strong results already happened — this is a fact, not a hypothetical the committee is imagining.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Concession
quests.contextSentence: ___ the second round confirms those same results, some committee members will likely still push for further review.
quests.completedSentence: Even if the second round confirms those same results, some committee members will likely still push for further review.
quests.ruleExplanation: The second round's outcome is still an unknown future possibility, so 'even if' introduces that hypothetical concession rather than one about a settled fact.
quests.nativeTip: This second round hasn't happened yet — it's still just a possible future outcome.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Concession
quests.contextSentence: ___ the company had never operated in that market before, it captured significant share within a year.
quests.completedSentence: Even though the company had never operated in that market before, it captured significant share within a year.

quests.nativeTip: The lack of prior experience in that market is an already-established fact, not a maybe.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Comparison

quests.completedSentence: Whereas the original policy prioritized short-term growth, the revised strategy focuses on long-term sustainability.
quests.ruleExplanation: This formal, document-style comparison of two policies fits the precise, official register of 'whereas' over its more casual counterpart.
quests.nativeTip: This reads like formal policy language comparing an old approach against a new one.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Comparison

quests.completedSentence: While European regulators have moved quickly on the new guidelines, their counterparts in other regions remain cautious.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Subordinating Conjunctions — Comparison

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Correlative Conjunctions — Alternatives
quests.contextSentence: ___ the negotiations succeed or collapse entirely, both sides have already spent considerable political capital on the issue.
quests.completedSentence: Whether the negotiations succeed or collapse entirely, both sides have already spent considerable political capital on the issue.
quests.ruleExplanation: The already-spent political capital doesn't depend on which outcome occurs, and 'whether' expresses that 'no matter which' sense.
quests.nativeTip: The political cost stays the same no matter which of the two outcomes actually happens.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Correlative Conjunctions — Alternatives
quests.contextSentence: The auditors must review every transaction, ___ or not the amounts appear significant.
quests.completedSentence: The auditors must review every transaction, whether or not the amounts appear significant.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Or not' is the fixed tail that only pairs with 'whether'; it can't grammatically attach to the other options here.
quests.nativeTip: Look at what follows the blank — that exact wording only ever pairs with one option.

quests.conceptTitle: Traffic Lights of Logic: Correlative Conjunctions — Alternatives

quests.completedSentence: Analysts remain divided over whether the slowdown is temporary or signals a deeper structural shift.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Whether' requires 'or' to complete the two named alternatives analysts are weighing here.
quests.nativeTip: Two possible explanations are being weighed against each other, and 'whether' needs its one fixed partner to complete that pair.
